transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess things just got a bit out of hand at work. I do landscaping. Usually I'm just a normal crew guy, you know? Keep my head down. But... I don't know, recently I just started trying to run three bids at the same time. Calling city people, lining up plant suppliers... I kept messaging everybody I knew about this park idea I had. It was just... like I couldn't shut it off. So... yeah. Here I am.
Have you been using any drugs or stimulants, like cocaine, recently?
Um, no. I don't... I don't mess with that stuff. Just... no drugs or anything.
Have you ever had a period, before this, where you felt unusually depressed, low, or lost interest in things for two weeks or more?

Um... yeah, I guess. I don't know. I used to try and clear my head by hiking... taking pictures of creek beds and trees and stuff. But lately... I just leave the camera in the truck. I don't really care if the light is perfect or not anymore. Just... haven't felt like doing it.

During this recent period of feeling so energized and full of plans, have you noticed anything unusual—like hearing voices or sounds others don't hear, seeing things others don't see, or feeling certain of things that others have told you aren't actually true?
Um... no. No, nothing like that. Just... just the work stuff. No voices or anything.

During this time of feeling so energized and full of plans, has it caused serious problems—like putting your job, finances, or relationships at risk, or having others step in because you weren't acting like yourself?

Um... I don't know about people stepping in. But... I guess work has been a little off. Just... I've been missing details on bids. Measurements and stuff. It's... I don't know, I just worry that one bad mistake is gonna cost me clients. Or... get someone hurt on the job site. So... yeah. It's been a problem, I guess.
About how many days in a row have you been feeling this unusually energetic and full of plans, without a break?

Um... I guess it was about two weeks. Started when I was getting everything ready for that big park pitch. Just felt really fired up, you know? But... then I crashed after that. So, yeah, maybe two weeks.
